rules: Every public numerical field uses a semantic quantity identifier and an explicit boundary unit.
A calculated value retains full finite binary64 precision; rounding belongs to presentation or an explicitly named construction rule.
Required, provided, selected and scheduled reinforcement are different quantities and cannot overwrite one another.

rules: Public fields include a unit suffix or carry a typed quantity whose schema declares the unit.
Conversions occur once at an adapter or public boundary and are recorded in effective inputs.
All numerical inputs and outputs must be finite; NaN and infinity are invalid input or software error, never engineering results.
Local axes form a right-handed system: local 1 follows increasing member station; local 2 and local 3 are stored with the source orientation.
P, V2, V3, T, M2 and M3 retain source signs and concurrency. Physical top, bottom, left and right faces are resolved by geometry plus axes rather than inferred from moment sign alone.
An adapter must return its source-to-common axis transform and unit conversion; it cannot rewrite signs without that transform.
A station contains physical member/span identity, distance from physical start, normalized ratio, and before/after side at a discontinuity.
Object and analysis-element stations remain separately traceable when an application subdivides a physical member.

action_bases.meaning: all six components belong to one identified static output row
all components belong to one case, stage and step
response-spectrum or modal result with its combination/recovery rule
component extrema may come from different rows and therefore are not concurrent
governing design values created by a declared, provenance-carrying rule

deliverables.concurrency_rule: An operation declares accepted action bases. A component envelope cannot silently satisfy an interaction check that requires concurrent components.

field_obligations.meaning: caller supplies a value when the named condition is true
a versioned profile supplies the value and the result returns its origin
may be omitted without changing engineering meaning

input_states.meaning: caller explicitly supplied no value; allowed only where the schema names that state
Excel cell or text was blank before typed conversion; never automatically numerical zero
caller supplied numerical zero and normal range/applicability rules apply
caller supplied the effective engineering value
a named, versioned default supplied the effective value
the value was calculated from identified upstream values and a named rule
two authoritative inputs disagree and the operation cannot choose silently

resolution_rules: Required absent, null or blank input is invalid.
Conditional input is resolved only after its condition is evaluated and recorded.
Defaulting is allowed only when the signature names the default source and version.
Derived values return their dependency identifiers and derivation rule.
Conflicting values require an explicit precedence policy or produce a field diagnostic.
Every result returns effective engineering inputs with state and origin so Python, .NET and Excel can replay the same calculation.

rules: Use UTF-8 JSON with lexicographically ordered object keys, preserved array order and canonical enum strings.
Represent finite binary64 numbers using the shortest round-trip decimal; distinguish integers only where the schema defines integer semantics.
Exclude acquisition time, display labels and presentation rounding from normalized_input_id unless they are declared engineering inputs.
Normalize units to PF4 canonical boundary units before hashing and include every effective value plus its semantic field identifier.
Use SHA-256 over the canonical bytes and prefix the digest with the identity kind and canonicalization version.

deliverables.freshness_rule: A result is current only when every bound upstream identity matches the active project state; a serializer-dependent object hash is never accepted as this proof.

rules: The dimensions are independent and must not be compressed into one pass/fail boolean.
Input rejection and software error are execution outcomes, not engineering failures.
Not applicable names a proven applicability decision; unknown or missing evidence remains not evaluated.
Approval is a human record with actor, time, scope and bound result identity; calculation never creates approval.
A partial or stale result cannot be represented as complete or approved for the active scope.
PF7 defines deterministic aggregation from leaf results without weakening these states.

exit_evidence.criterion: Legacy ambiguous terms have a new meaning or compatibility translation.
evidence: PF4-D1 defines 37 quantity meanings and explicit translations for span, steel area, cover, bar length and cost.

exit_evidence.criterion: Zero, blank, absent, default and derived values are distinct.
evidence: PF4-D3 defines eight input states, four field obligations and resolution rules.

exit_evidence.criterion: Equivalent Python and .NET values can be compared without guessing.
evidence: PF4-D2 fixes units/axes/concurrency and PF4-D4 defines cross-language canonical input and calculation identities.
